method: expanded alias/full-name and primary-source literature search; no automatic promotion
search_scope: All 112 mouse canonical-TF/direct-binding queue rows were covered by grouped searches using regulator aliases, target aliases/full names, mouse, ChIP-seq/ChIP-qPCR, promoter, reporter, knockdown, knockout, loss-of-function, and direct-target terms; surfaced primary papers and local source provenance were checked for exact regulator-target support.

search_layers.name: local_tflink_gtrd_provenance
search_layers.scope: Per-protein TFLink mouse target tables and the imported graph source rows
search_layers.finding: Rows preserve mouse TF/target identifiers, GTRD as source database, PMID 27924024, TFLink source record IDs, and raw snapshot paths; no underlying GTRD experiment accession was present in the local snapshot.

search_layers.name: gtrd_resource_review
search_layers.scope: Official GTRD documentation and integrated ChIP-seq resource description
search_layers.finding: GTRD is a uniformly processed TF-binding resource; its source-table membership does not establish functional target response or exact-pair biological direction.

search_layers.name: grouped_exact_pair_search
search_layers.scope: ARNT2, ASCL2, BHLHA15/MIST1, DMRTB1, EBF2, FEZF2, FOXK1, GRHL3, HES5, HIVEP3/ZAS3, HOXA13, HOXC12, ISX, MYT1L, NEUROD2, NPAS4, PRDM15, PURB, RBPJL, RFX6, SOX3, ZFAT, ZFP319, ZFP652, ZFX, and ZNF281/ZFP281 with all queued targets and aliases
search_layers.finding: No exact queued pair met the promotion contract of mouse compatibility, direct sequence-specific binding, functional target response, stable primary citation, and supported direction.

search_layers.name: near_match_primary_paper_review
search_layers.scope: Primary mouse papers surfaced by the grouped and exact-pair searches
search_layers.finding: Several papers validate different pairs or programs: ARNT2/NPAS4 activity-dependent neuronal regulation; GRHL3/RhoGEF19 wound repair; PRDM15 developmental targets; SOX3/Ngn3; NEUROD2/Ulip1 or Stim1; NPAS4/Bdnf/c-Fos; RFX6 pancreatic programs; and ZFAT adipocyte targets. None is an exact queued pair with the required functional evidence.

search_layers.name: exact_alias_followups
search_layers.scope: Selected difficult pairs including FEZF2-Acvr1, HOXC12-Angptl4, HES5-Adam22, NEUROD2-Adam10, NPAS4-Adam22, PRDM15-Adgrl1/Adgrl2, SOX3-Adcyap1r1/Adgrl2, ZFX-Adam17/Adam22, and ZFP319-Cap1/ZFP652-Adam17
search_layers.finding: Searches produced near matches, pathway or expression records, or non-mouse/non-exact results, but no promotion-grade exact pair.

primary_evidence_leads.pair_scope: ARNT2 neuronal program, not queued targets
primary_evidence_leads.finding: Mouse neuronal ARNT2/NCoR2/NPAS4 ChIP-seq and RNA-seq study; it does not establish ARNT2->A2m, ARNT2->Abca1, ARNT2->Ackr3, or ARNT2->Actr2.

primary_evidence_leads.pair_scope: GRHL3 wound-repair target, not queued targets
primary_evidence_leads.finding: Mouse GRHL3 direct target RhoGEF19 with occupancy and functional evidence; the queued GRHL3 targets are different.

primary_evidence_leads.pair_scope: PRDM15 developmental targets, not queued targets
primary_evidence_leads.finding: Mouse embryonic PRDM15 ChIP-seq/ChIP-qPCR and expression evidence for targets including Rbpj, Notch3, Maml3, Vangl2, Wnt5b, and others; no queued PRDM15 pair was established.

primary_evidence_leads.pair_scope: SOX3 neural/testis target, not queued targets
primary_evidence_leads.finding: Mouse SOX3 binding and functional regulation of Ngn3 in postnatal testis; no queued SOX3 target was established.

primary_evidence_leads.pair_scope: NEUROD2 neuronal targets, not queued targets
primary_evidence_leads.finding: Mouse neuronal progenitor evidence supports direct NeuroD2 regulation of Ulip1; it does not establish the queued Adam10, Actr2, Acvr1, or Acvr1c pairs.

primary_evidence_leads.pair_scope: NPAS4 neuronal targets, not queued targets
primary_evidence_leads.finding: Mouse hippocampal NPAS4 occupancy and functional regulation include Bdnf and c-Fos; no queued NPAS4 target was established.

primary_evidence_leads.pair_scope: RFX6 pancreatic targets, not queued targets
primary_evidence_leads.finding: Mouse RFX6 developmental evidence concerns pancreatic/islet programs and does not establish the queued Adm, Crhr2, Cx3cl1, or Cxcr4 pairs.

primary_evidence_leads.pair_scope: ZFAT adipocyte targets, not queued targets
primary_evidence_leads.finding: Mouse Zfat evidence identifies Atg13, Brf1, Psmc3, and Timm22 as targets; it does not establish the queued pairs.

new_module_evidence_reconciliation.finding: The newly graded Module 22B/23B edge and evidence registers were scanned against the queued public-TF pairs. No exact structured queue-pair overlap was identified; the graded mechanism evidence therefore did not support a new public-TF promotion.

limitations: Search results do not establish absence from all literature.
The search did not recover underlying GTRD experiment accessions from the local TFLink snapshot.
A binding-only result, database membership, expression association, pathway relation, or related-target paper is insufficient for exact-pair functional promotion.
No spinal-cord or SCI context was inferred from general mouse or neural papers.
Full-text supplements and non-indexed records may still contain evidence requiring manual retrieval and review.
